correctness.rationale: Explicit halving-digit cut bijection is reconstructed; F(t) is strictly decreasing; all hyperbinary expansions have weight W>=h-3, and each of W=h-3, W=h-2, W>=h-1 is handled without gaps. W=h-2 corresponds bijectively to legal one-carry reversals, counted by one-runs of u-1. Three exact independent computations corroborate finite cases; the general conclusion is proved symbolically.
